text:
Maya: Heads up — nightly GPU CI turned red after this morning's firmware bump on the h100 canary. Several warmup jobs hung and a couple reported OOMs.

ci-bot: Job 983421 (gpu-nightly/canary) failed on pods h100-1a,h100-2b: kernel error Xid 87 then container restart.

Maya: We rolled firmware v1.4.2 at 2026-03-16T02:12Z; driver stayed at 536.05. Failing jobs only on nodes with that firmware.

Sam: Are these new kernel messages? Any stack traces? :eyes:

ci-bot: log excerpt:
```
[  512.345678] NVRM: Xid (0001:0087): GPU has fallen off the bus.
[  512.345789] nvgpu: fatal: nvhost: gpu_recover failed
Traceback (most recent call last):
  ...
```

Anya: Could be firmware-driver mismatch or a regress in our warmup sequence (batch size/back-to-back sessions). I can trigger a controlled rerun with reduced parallelism.

Ben: I'll bisect the firmware pack. Starting with nodes that passed last night vs failed now.

Ben: Running:
/rerun ci gpu-nightly --job 983421 --compare=2026-03-15T23:00Z,2026-03-16T02:00Z --shards h100-1a

Liam: SRE — please hold any further firmware rollouts to prod canary pools until we triage. Paging @infra.

infra-bot: Paused rollout id=fw-rollout-2026-0316 for pool=h100-canary by request of Liam.

Maya: If bisect points to firmware, we'll need rollback plan + signal to partners. Also adding a hotfix: lower warmup concurrency and enable KV cache prefetch.

Sam: Quick ask — can someone attach the job artifacts (nvml logs + dmesg) to the ticket? will help correlate.

Maya: Uploaded artifacts to ticket REDWOOD-3342, added notes and repro steps. :white_check_mark:

Anya: I'll run reduced-parallel rerun now and post results in thread.

Anya: Rerun done — warmup completed on h100-1a with concurrency=1, no OOM; high concurrency still hits Xid 87.

Ben: Bisect finding: firmware v1.4.2 regresses against warmup concurrency >4. Root repro on bare-metal one-shot.

Liam: Good find. I'll coordinate rollback schedule and hold production rollout until patch.

Maya: Thanks all. Next steps: (1) rollback firmware on canary pool, (2) SRE to block further rollouts, (3) Ben to open upstream firmware bug with vendor, (4) add CI guard to reduce default warmup concurrency until patch.

Maya: tagging folks who need to follow up: @Ben @Anya @Liam @Sam :memo:
